column1: # Swedish (sv) interface catalog. Columns, separated by a TAB:
#   context    empty (WordCraft uses no contexts yet)
#   source     the English text exactly as in the code (tl!(...), ribbon labels, command labels)
#   escapes    \n  \t  \\  inside a column. `{name}` placeholders must appear in both
#              columns, and a trailing "…" in one needs one in the other.
#   Lines starting with # and blank lines are ignored. A missing entry shows in English.
# Clean room: translated from the meaning of the English labels in this repository into ordinary
# Swedish computing vocabulary. No Microsoft Word (or other product) localisation, string table or
# translated UI was consulted or copied; add entries the same way.
# Product, format and technology names (WordCraft, PDF, Markdown, MCP …) stay as they are.
# Conventions: commands are imperatives (Spara, Infoga), tabs and groups are nouns; Swedish nouns
# agree with a number, so count labels are a label and a colon ("Ord: 21", "Rader: {n}") and read
# right at every count; quotes are ”…” and a colon takes no space before it.
